$extensions.aesthetic: bold developer analytics -- playful, anti-corporate, data-obsessed

surface.$description: Primary dark background -- PostHog's native dark canvas for dashboards and app chrome

surface-light.$description: Light mode background -- clean near-white for marketing pages and docs

surface-elevated.$description: Elevated card surface on dark -- sidebar panels, dashboard cards, modals

surface-elevated-light.$description: Elevated card surface on light -- white cards on near-white background

surface-input.$description: Input field and dropdown background on dark surfaces

surface-hover.$description: Row hover, list item hover, sidebar item active on dark

surface-code.$description: Code block and terminal background -- slightly cooler than main dark surface

surface-yellow-highlight.$description: Muted yellow highlight for feature flags, experiment banners on dark

accent.$description: PostHog Orange -- the signature brand color, used for primary CTAs and brand moments only

accent-hover.$description: Darker orange for hover/pressed states on primary buttons

accent-light.$description: Faint orange tint for light-mode hover backgrounds and selected states

accent-muted.$description: Muted warm-dark tone for orange-tinted backgrounds on dark surfaces

text-primary.$description: Primary text on dark -- slightly warm off-white, never pure white

text-primary-light.$description: Primary text on light surfaces -- near-black

text-secondary.$description: Secondary text on dark -- muted cool gray for descriptions and metadata

text-tertiary.$description: De-emphasized text, timestamps, helper text on dark

text-on-accent.$description: White text on orange accent buttons and badges

text-link.$description: Link text color -- uses brand orange for high visibility

error.$description: Error/danger -- slightly warmer red than Material, distinct from brand orange

error-bg.$description: Error background tint on dark surfaces

success.$description: Success/positive -- muted green that works on both dark and light

success-bg.$description: Success background tint on dark surfaces

warning.$description: Warning/caution -- warm amber distinct from brand orange

warning-bg.$description: Warning background tint on dark surfaces

info.$description: Informational state -- standard blue for notices and tooltips

border.$description: Default border on dark -- subtle separation without visual weight

border-strong.$description: Emphasized border on dark -- table headers, active input focus ring

border-accent.$description: Accent border for active tabs, selected states, focus indicators

focus.$description: Focus ring color -- blue for accessibility contrast against orange brand

chart-1.$description: Chart series 1 -- primary blue for trends and main metric

chart-2.$description: Chart series 2 -- purple for secondary data series

chart-3.$description: Chart series 3 -- brand orange for highlighted/target series

chart-4.$description: Chart series 4 -- teal-green for success/positive metrics

chart-5.$description: Chart series 5 -- amber for warning/attention series

chart-6.$description: Chart series 6 -- pink-coral for additional contrast

chart-7.$description: Chart series 7 -- lighter blue for extended palettes

chart-8.$description: Chart series 8 -- light purple for extended palettes

funnel-step.$description: Funnel step fill -- semi-transparent blue bars in conversion funnels

funnel-drop.$description: Funnel drop-off area -- muted gray for lost users between steps

retention-high.$description: Retention heatmap high value -- saturated blue for strong retention

retention-low.$description: Retention heatmap low value -- fades into dark surface for poor retention

font-display.$value: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
font-display.$description: Headlines and display text -- IBM Plex Sans Variable, PostHog's brand font with humanist character

font-body.$value: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
font-body.$description: Body and UI text -- same family, unifying the whole product around a single typeface

font-mono.$value: Source Code Pro, JetBrains Mono, Menlo, monospace
font-mono.$description: Code, HogQL queries, technical output -- developer-friendly monospace

scale-overline.$description: Uppercase overline labels, chart axis labels

scale-caption.$description: Sidebar nav items, tooltip text, chart legends

scale-small.$description: Secondary body text, button labels, dropdown items

scale-base.$description: Standard body text -- PostHog uses 15px as app body default

scale-lg.$description: Lead paragraphs, intro text on marketing pages

scale-2xl.$description: Section headings within dashboards and settings

scale-display.$description: Hero display text -- bold and punchy, not oversized

line-height-tight.$description: Display and hero headings -- compact for impact

line-height-normal.$description: Body text -- comfortable reading without excessive spacing

weight-medium.$description: Button text, nav labels, emphasized body

weight-semibold.$description: Headings and section titles -- PostHog prefers semibold over bold for headlines

weight-bold.$description: Display headlines and hero text -- reserved for maximum impact

letter-spacing-tight.$description: Negative tracking on display and hero text for tighter headlines

letter-spacing-overline.$description: Wide tracking on uppercase overline labels

unit.$description: Base grid unit -- PostHog uses 4px grid for dense analytics layouts

2xs.$description: Micro gaps -- icon-to-label in compact toolbar items

xs.$description: Tight inline spacing -- badge padding, compact list gaps

sm.$description: Small gaps -- button padding vertical, table cell padding

md.$description: Standard gap -- form field spacing, button padding horizontal

lg.$description: Card internal padding small, sidebar item padding

xl.$description: Card padding standard, content block margins

2xl.$description: Dashboard card padding, modal content padding

3xl.$description: Section internal padding, large card bodies

4xl.$description: Page section vertical padding on marketing pages

section-gap.$description: Vertical spacing between major page sections

page-margin-desktop.$description: Page content margin on desktop -- tighter than marketing sites because of sidebar nav

container-max.$description: Maximum content width for marketing pages

container-app.$description: App layout fills available width -- sidebar + main content model

sidebar-width.$description: Navigation sidebar width in the app shell

radius-sm.$description: Small elements -- badges, inline code, chips

radius-md.$description: Buttons, inputs, dropdowns -- the workhorse radius

radius-pill.$description: Pill-shaped badges, toggle switches, small status indicators

level-0.$description: Flat -- no elevation, used for inline elements and flat cards with border-only containment

level-1.$description: Subtle lift -- dropdowns, tooltips, popovers on dark surfaces

level-2.$description: Elevated -- modals, command palette, expanded menus

level-3.$description: Heavy lift -- full-screen overlays, dragged elements (use sparingly)

glow-accent.$description: Orange glow -- CTA hover emphasis on dark backgrounds, sparingly used

duration-instant.$description: Instant feedback -- toggle switches, checkbox ticks

duration-fast.$description: Fast transitions -- hover states, button press, tab switch

duration-normal.$description: Standard transitions -- dropdowns, tooltips, sidebar collapse

duration-slow.$description: Deliberate transitions -- modal entrance, chart animations, page transitions

easing-chart.$description: Chart-specific easing -- data point transitions and bar growth

mobile.$description: Mobile -- single column, bottom nav, stacked dashboard cards

desktop.$description: Desktop -- persistent sidebar, full dashboard grid

wide.$description: Wide desktop -- expanded chart widths, multi-panel layouts
